description: Result of the repro stage: one failing test that proves the issue.

reproduced.description: True when a test has been prepared for the harness to execute and check against the expected assertion. The harness, not the agent, decides whether it reproduces.

crate.description: Cargo package name of the crate holding the test, as accepted by `cargo test -p`.

test_file.description: Repository-relative path of the new test file, forward slashes (e.g. tests/issue_123.rs or src/parser/issue_123_tests.rs).

test_name.description: The test's name exactly as cargo prints it: the bare function name for an integration test, the module path for a unit-test module (e.g. parser::issue_123_tests::issue_123_rejects_short_frame).

expected.description: Short verbatim substring of the failing output that proves the bug (assertion message or panic text). No paths, line numbers or timings. Must be non-empty when reproduced is true.

observed.description: What actually happened when the command was run (key output lines).

registration_file.description: For a unit-test module: the existing source file that received the `#[cfg(test)] mod issue_<n>_tests;` line. Null for an integration test.

notes.description: What the fixer should know; when reproduced is false, why the issue could not be reproduced.
